study type: secondary analysis of prospective cohort data
outcome: excess weight loss (EWL, >=10% of birth weight)
cohort: Exclusively breastfed mother-infant dyads from the U.S. site of the WHO Growth Reference Study, after exclusions for NEWT-specific criteria, missing data, or formula consumption.
finding: The Newborn Weight Loss Tool (NEWT) demonstrated low sensitivity (21%) in predicting excess weight loss (EWL) when applied at about 24 hours of life, though an early test-positive status was associated with greater weight loss and indicators of breastfeeding difficulties on day 4.
